## Oddlings of the Wobblewood

A complete, original, whimsical survival game. Open `index.html` in a browser (or serve this folder with `python3 -m http.server 3002`) and play.

- Move with **WASD** or the **arrow keys**; on phones, use the on-screen joystick.
- Your poppywand automatically targets nearby grumble-goblins. Tap **✦** on touchscreens for an extra cast.
- Collect glimmers to level up and pick upgrades. Press **Space** or the pause button to pause.

Last three minutes to win—or see how long you can last!

content.text:
Built **Oddlings of the Wobblewood**, a playable, original whimsical survival game with a nonsense-storybook feel.

- Open `index.html` to play.
- Move with **WASD** or **arrow keys**; on mobile, use the joystick.
- Your poppywand auto-targets grumble-goblins. Collect glimmers to level up and choose upgrades.
- Survive for three minutes to win, or see how long you can last.

I also added play instructions to `README.md` and checked the game in desktop and mobile browser views. The characters and world are original rather than using Dr. Seuss characters.
